title: Pictures by Women: A History of Modern Photograpy
description: For much of photography's 170-year history, women have expanded its roles by experimenting with every aspect of the medium. This exhibition presents a selection of outstanding photographs by women artists, charting the medium's history from the dawn of the modern period to the present.

title: Underground Gallery: London Transport Posters 1920s-1940s
description: After World War I, striking modern posters began to transform the stations of London's underground railway system into public art galleries.
